_note: Green-flag pit loss (s) per circuit, used for a wet-affected race (docs/pit-loss-spec.md P1). 'measured' is the median of that circuit's dry races; 'estimate' is a published typical figure where no dry race is in the game yet. 'before': the loss up to a season, for a pit lane rebuilt since.

before.note: Before the 2022 changes the pit lane was narrower and limited to 60 km/h (80 from 2022): https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2022_Australian_Grand_Prix, citing Speedcafe. Measured from australia-2019 alone (races batch 3).
